headwords: mắt chữ O mồm chữ A

flags.why: For a cricket, càng refers to the hind legs, not pincers, as illustrated in [Wiktionary](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/mẫm_bóng).
flags.fix: This cricket has plump, firm hind legs.

flags.why: Mật phục means to lie in wait secretly to catch someone, not an undercover police officer, as shown in [police reporting](https://congan.com.vn/vu-an/thua-thien-hue-cong-an-phuong-mat-phuc-bat-doi-tuong-tang-tru-ma-tuy_136423.html).
flags.fix: verb | to lie in wait secretly; to stake out

flags.why: The example defines the word instead of showing it in use.
The skin lesion called mắt cá is a corn, not a plantar wart, as explained by [Nguyễn Tri Phương Hospital](https://bvnguyentriphuong.com.vn/kham-da-lieu-chuyen-sau/mat-ca-va-vet-chai).
flags.fix: corn (a small, painful area of thickened skin, usually on the foot)

flags.why: Mắt cá in this example means a corn rather than a plantar wart.
flags.fix: I have a corn on my foot, so walking hurts.

flags.why: This use is a vulgar curse, and colloquial alone does not warn the learner.
